title: Ungradeable (real)
description: A genuine APTOS image that fails the quality gate on BOTH focus and illumination. The recapture advice names lighting as the likely root cause, because severe uneven lighting drags the focus score down: measured on 33 illumination-degraded images, 29 tripped both checks and none tripped illumination alone. Kept at native resolution.
